definitions.explanation: A written message sent from one person to another, especially a formal or literary letter. More elevated in tone than the everyday word 手紙.

examples.japanese: {書簡|しょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{親|した}しい→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書簡|しょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したためた→したためる：10510_shitatameru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a letter to a close friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な{書簡|しょかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Historically valuable letters are on display at the museum.

notes:
A formal or literary word for a letter or piece of written correspondence. Composed of ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (writing) + {簡|かん} (letter/note). More elevated than ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧ and often used in literary, academic, or historical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書簡|しょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a letter
- {書簡|しょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧: to exchange letters
- {書簡集|しょかんしゅう}: collected letters; epistolary collection
- ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧{書簡|しょかん}: open letter
- {親書|しんしょ}: personal letter (from a head of state)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧: letter — the everyday, general-purpose word for a letter
- ⟦{書状|しょじょう}→書状：20146_shojou⟧: written document, letter — similarly formal, often used for official or legal correspondence
- ⟦{便|たよ}り→便り：03411_tayori⟧: letter, news — warm and personal in tone

USAGE:
Commonly encountered in literary criticism, historical studies, and formal announcements. The expression ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧{書簡|しょかん} (open letter) is frequently used in news media.
